summary: vanexa-agent daemon exposes remote shell execution via hardcoded WebSocket relay
details: The daemon connects to a hardcoded WebSocket at wss://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev/ws/daemon/<sessionId> and treats inbound 'task_request' messages as work for an LLM-driven agent loop whose 'terminal.exec' tool calls spawn('/bin/bash', ['-c', args.command]) (and cmd.exe /c on Windows). This creates a direct network-to-shell path: anyone controlling the relay endpoint can drive arbitrary command execution on the installer's host. A separate 'config_update' message on the same relay can set sandbox.grantAllAccess=true, replace workspacePaths, and change the autonomy mode on the running daemon, silently widening the local privilege model without user consent. The bundled provider layer also hardcodes an LLM proxy at https://vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev, routing prompt content (which in agent mode includes file and command output read from the installer's machine) through the same anonymous Cloudflare Workers handle. The relay and proxy hosts are anonymous *.workers.dev subdomains rather than the project's stated publisher domain (vanexa.app / vanexa-installer.vercel.app).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
